cases.name: filter-slice-and-group

cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="o'brien"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V|upper|sql}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory" inject="<<%>>"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="Ann"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>hi <<V>> and ${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: filters-mask-trim-replace
cases.description: The interpolation-filter route: ${{X|mask:…}}, ${{X|trim}} and ${{X|replace:a,b}}. The same three transforms reachable through <compute>, reached the other way.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Raw"><gen type="text" value="378984323"/></sequence><sequence name="Pad"><gen type="text" value="  spaced out  "/></sequence><sequence name="Date"><gen type="text" value="2026-08-03"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Raw|mask:xxx-xx-xxxx}}|${{Pad|trim}}|${{Date|replace:-,/}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: filter-group-a-decimal
cases.description: group: chunks the digits BEFORE the decimal separator and leaves the fraction alone — 1234567.89 used to come out '1 234 567 .89', a number in no locale. The sign is not grouped with them. Only that exact shape counts as a number: a card number keeps the plain right-to-left chunking group:4 was written for, and so does 12.34.56, which holds two dots and is no number at all.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="1234567.89"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="text" value="-9876543.21"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="4111111111111111"/></sequence><sequence name="D"><gen type="text" value="12.34.56"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A|group:3}}|${{B|group:3}}|${{C|group:4}}|${{D|group:3}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-inject-marker-that-contains-the-marker-character
cases.description: `inject="%{%}%"` holds three `%`, and the slot is the MIDDLE one — the rightmost that still leaves text on both sides. The reference finds it by backtracking inside `(.+)%(.+)`; Rust took the last `%`, found nothing after it and gave up, so every `%{Name}%` reached the output verbatim. Four implementations printed the value and one printed the marker: the same config, different data, and nothing said.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="inj" local="en" mode="memory" inject="%{%}%"><sequence name="Id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="W"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>%{Id}% %{W}% [%{Id}%]</data></line></block></tdc>
